answer: Two devices resting on the same floor feel the same tiny vibrations when a door closes or footsteps pass, and their accelerometer traces correlate in a way distant devices cannot match, under a nebula of faint tremors. The tremor travels through a ledge above the room faithfully, a tundra of silence elsewhere proves nothing, and no software can invent the shared waveform after the fact, so a farm would need paired hardware in every claimed building.
